factor_diagnostics.value_notes: Langan et al. (2024) modeled chum marine preferred SST at 1.3-12.6 °C (80% HDI), core 2.8-9.3 °C, median 7.1 °C and modal 5.8 °C. A 2025 NOAA-authored migration-corridor study also uses SST-based thermal suitability for western Alaska chum and identifies low suitability at warm/cold migration margins. The configured 6-14 °C range and 8-12 °C ideal are shifted warm and omit much of the colder modeled preference. These are North Pacific stock/migration results, not a universal local catch curve.
